description: This file defines an enumeration (enum) named PdfAcroFieldFlags in the namespace PdfSharp.Pdf.AcroForms. The enum specifies various flags that can be applied to AcroForm fields in PDF documents, such as ReadOnly, Required, NoExport, and various flags specific to button, text, and choice fields, with detailed documentation for each.

classes.name: PdfAcroFieldFlags
classes.description: An enumeration representing flags for PDF AcroForm fields, used to specify properties such as read-only, required, multi-line, password, combo box, and other field behaviors.
